finalText:
**Builds clean now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs were hiding in the warning noise, both from the bundler bump changing option shapes.

- [`src/core/options.js`](src/core/options.js) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to use `retryCount`.
- [`src/net/retryPolicy.js`](src/net/retryPolicy.js) threw on `undefined` backoff flags. New config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, so I made it just check `=== true`.

Rest of the warnings are genuine deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc), not blockers.

Next: nothing.
